# HTG — Hex The Government

> Independent record label. Site: https://www.htg.productions · Tagline: Depressions Running Deep · Bookings: Bookings@htg.productions

Disambiguation: several unrelated artists on Spotify are also called ABRAXAS and Stretty. The HTG artists are exactly the Spotify artist IDs listed below.
